svg.title: SIP ladder through CUBE
svg.desc: INVITE from Unified CM, CUBE dial-peer match, INVITE to the provider, responses back, ACK, then RTP. A 488 or a missing outbound peer dies before media.

g.text: 1 · INVITE (may lack SDP if delayed offer)
2 · INVITE out the WAN peer (early offer if forced)
4 · ACK. SDP answer must already agree.
5 · RTP. One-way audio is a media path, not a SIP code.
If step 2 never happens, look for no outbound dial-peer or a busyout peer [cite:4].
488 Not Acceptable Here is a codec or SDP refusal [cite:11]. 403 is often trust, identity, or policy.
